## Selected achievements
- **Strategy-to-Execution Transformation.** Converted strategy into execution at Human Technopole, delivering 30% efficiency improvement and 45% manual-process reduction through targeted digital modernization and automation.
- **Cybersecurity & Control Maturity.** Embedded GDPR-aligned security governance and operational controls across core services, contributing to a 60% reduction in security incidents.
- **Scalable Operating Reliability.** Stabilized and scaled infrastructure supporting 20PB+ scientific workloads while maintaining 99.99% service reliability in production environments.
- **Governance, Capital Efficiency & Vendor Performance.** Restructured supplier governance and contract strategy to produce 40-60% optimization in targeted agreements and improve service accountability.
